faqs.a:
(a)
No property outside of the city that is eligible for annexation to the city will be
               served either water or sewer service by the city until such property is annexed to
               the city.
(b)
It is the policy of the city not to provide water or sewer service to property outside
               of the city that is not eligible for annexation; provided, however, that the city
               council may grant either water service or sewer service to property outside of the
               city not eligible for annexation if the city council finds and determines that it
               is in the best interest of the city to provide water service or sewer service outside
               of the city.
(c)
A request by a property owner for water or sewer service outside of the city will
               first be considered by the planning commission, which will refer the request to the
               city council with a recommendation for denial or for approval.
(d)
All water and sewer fees must be paid in cash or certified funds prior to city council
               consideration of water or sewer service outside of the city. Should the city council
               deny the request, the city will refund the fees to the property owner.
(Code 1981, § 33-21; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
